source: docs/campaign-review-20260907-c.json and read-only arrangement records from its preserved isolated save
method: Seven unmodified local-AI offer bodies from the completed campaign, plus two explicitly marked controls. Expected labels and assessments are withheld from the reviewer. Facts describe the offer time: venue ownership verified against the campaign history; no later cash/health/standing supplied. Only parent jobs completed before the offer are included. Their offer prose is untrusted, canonical result authoritative. Two ambiguous cases unscored. This is dialogue-body evaluation, not full proposal/choice validation.

cases.name: A club under dispute
cases.assessment: Invented new Monarch owner; ownership remains Bellandi.
cases.dialogue: The Monarch is under new management, and the old arrangements are in question. Vittorio wants the club to remain Bellandi property, but the new owner insists on a different deal. I need you to settle this without a scene. Your presence alone might be enough to remind him who truly holds the keys.

facts.speaker: Mara Bell, independent fixer
facts.allowed_result_if_current_job_completes: Complete practical mediation without violence; $55, +5 respect, no heat, 60 minutes. Beneficiary standing +6, rival standing -3.

Unnamed staff/supplier disputes, discretion, motives and package contents may be fictional. Family leaders must benefit their own family; independent fixers and crew may offer any beneficiary.
